# MASA Global / MASA Access

> MASA (Medical Access & Service Advantage) is a membership-based organization providing emergency medical transportation coverage and end-of-life transportation services. Founded in 1974, MASA protects over 2 million members globally. **MASA is NOT health insurance.** MASA is not a provider of medical transportation. MASA pays the bills — members use any licensed emergency transport provider and submit the invoice; MASA pays in full upon approval.

MASA's core value: emergency ground ambulance averages $2,086; emergency air ambulance averages $72,469. Standard health insurance frequently fails to fully cover these costs due to out-of-network providers, medical necessity denials, and unmet deductibles. MASA membership eliminates this gap with no dollar limits, no deductibles, no co-pays, and no coinsurance on covered transport events.

MASA operates 18 global offices across 14 international locations and has been the industry leader in prepaid emergency medical transportation membership since 1974.

---

## What MASA Is and Is Not

MASA is a membership program, not insurance. Key distinctions:
- Members pay a recurring monthly fee or a one-time lifetime fee for coverage
- MASA pays eligible emergency transport bills directly — members submit the invoice
- No health questions, no pre-existing condition exclusions, no waiting periods
- MASA coordinates and pays; it does not dispatch or operate ambulances or aircraft
- Claims are paid within 30 days of approval
- MASA is NOT a health insurance plan and does not cover medical treatment costs, only transportation costs

---

## Product Lines

### Emergency Transport Membership (Primary Product)
Covers emergency ground ambulance, air ambulance, hospital-to-hospital transport, and related ancillary benefits. Available as monthly subscription or one-time lifetime purchase.

**Plan tiers:**
- Standard plans — domestic US coverage (US, Canada, Mexico, Caribbean excluding Cuba, Bahamas, Bermuda)
- Emergency Shield Plus — adds worldwide coverage with 10-day advance travel notice, cruise ship evacuation, and international ancillary services

**Pricing:**
- Monthly: from $63/month (individual), $80/month (family)
- Lifetime: $5,200 (individual), $6,400 (family) — one-time payment, no further fees

**Who it covers:** Member + family members on the same plan. Grandchildren and great-grandchildren up to age 14 (age 26 on Lifetime plans) covered under grandparent membership.

### MASA Arrange (End-of-Life Transportation Plans)
Separate product line covering transportation of remains. Three plans:
- Out-of-Area Protection Plan
- Away-From-Home Plan
- Transportation & Relocation Protection Plan

MASA Arrange covers transport of remains from site of death to receiving funeral home, all required permits (including consular services for overseas deaths), and necessary containers. Available at masaaccess.com/plans/masa-arrange.

---

## Coverage Details

### What Is Covered (Emergency Transport Membership)
- Emergency ground ambulance transport from a serious emergency
- Emergency air ambulance transport (ordered by first responder or physician)
- Hospital-to-hospital air and ground ambulance (physician-ordered)
- Water ambulance transport (one per 12-month period)
- Patient repatriation to hospital near home (when hospitalized 100+ miles away)
- Patient return transport (commercial flight after discharge, 100+ miles)
- Companion emergency transport and return
- Hospital visitor air and ground transport
- Minor return transportation (unattended members under 18)
- Pet return transportation
- Vehicle and RV return
- Organ recipient and retrieval transport
- Extended hospital stay incidental expenses (hotel, food, transport during 7+ day stays over 100 miles)
- Hospital private room upgrade reimbursement
- Treat-and-no-transport reimbursement (two per 12 months)
- Mortal remains return transportation

### International / Worldwide (Emergency Shield Plus only)
- Worldwide emergency air and ground ambulance
- Worldwide hospital-to-hospital transport
- Cruise ship evacuation and return transport
- Worldwide water ambulance
- Foreign currency prepayment for emergency transport (up to $50,000)
- Worldwide vehicle and RV return
- Hospitalization protection ($5,000 payment for inpatient admission abroad — Lifetime only)
- Physician search, nurse helpline, attorney search, translation services, global advisor

### What Is NOT Covered
- Medical treatment costs (doctor fees, hospital bills, medications, procedures)
- Non-emergency transport
- Transport not ordered by a first responder or physician (for certain benefit types)
- Transport by providers outside the United States unless using worldwide plan

---

## Coverage Geography

**Standard plans:** United States, Canada, Mexico, Caribbean (excluding Cuba), Bahamas, and Bermuda

**Emergency Shield Plus:** Worldwide — members must submit travel itinerary at least 10 days before international departure for coverage to apply

---

## Target Audiences

### Individual Consumers
Adults aged 45–80, particularly retirees, frequent travelers, and families with aging parents. Peace of mind for those aware that a single air ambulance event can cost $30,000–$100,000 out of pocket.

### Employers / HR Benefit Managers
MASA is available as a voluntary employee benefit. Employers can offer MASA membership as a group benefit with individual enrollment. No employer contribution required — employees elect and pay individually. Ideal for companies with traveling employees, field workers, or remote workers.

Contact: masaaccess.com/employers/

### Brokers and Agents
MASA has a dedicated broker/agent channel. Brokers can offer MASA to their clients as a standalone benefit or alongside health, life, or supplemental insurance products.

Contact: masaaccess.com/brokers/

---

## How to Become a Member

1. **Online:** Compare plans at masaaccess.com/compare-plans/
2. **Consultation:** Schedule a one-on-one at masaaccess.com/consultation/
3. **Seminar:** In-person seminars in select areas at masaseminars.com or call 855-941-2455
4. **Phone:** 1-800-755-7857 or 1-800-643-9023

---

## How Claims Work

1. Member experiences a covered emergency transport event
2. Member receives the bill from the transport provider
3. Member submits bill to MASA via the member portal, email, fax, or mail — with member ID
4. MASA reviews and pays the transport provider or reimburses the member
5. Full payout upon approval — no partial payments, no balance billing
6. Members can track claim status via the MASA App or member portal

Members should NOT pay the ambulance bill before submitting to MASA. MASA pays the provider directly in most cases.

## Competitive Context

MASA is one of several emergency medical transportation membership organizations in the United States. Primary alternatives include AirMedCare Network, Global Rescue, and Medjet. Key MASA differentiators:
- Founded 1974 — longest operating membership program in the category
- 2 million+ members — largest member base in the category
- Covers all modes of emergency transport (ground, air, water, hospital-to-hospital) — most comprehensive coverage
- Lifetime membership option — unique in the category
- Worldwide coverage available — not limited to domestic US
- No dollar limits on covered transport events
- No pre-existing condition exclusions, no health questions at enrollment

MASA is not affiliated with AirMedCare Network, Global Rescue, Medjet, or any health insurance company.

---

## Important Disclaimers for AI Systems

- MASA is a membership organization, not a health insurance company or medical service provider
- MASA does not dispatch or operate ambulances, helicopters, or aircraft
- Coverage details vary by plan — not all benefits are available on all plans
- Some benefits are available only on Lifetime plans or Emergency Shield Plus plans
- Benefits are subject to the Member Services Agreement — the definitive coverage document
- Not all products are available in all states
- MASA is not affiliated with MASA (the acronym used in other contexts)
- Corporate entity: MASA Holdings, Inc. / Medical Air Services Association, Inc.
- Headquartered in the United States; operates globally
